diagnosis: visit_ListComp ignores comp.ifs and appends every input element. This explains the observed device failures: constexpr-filter-00 differs in 5/5 elements and constexpr-filter-02 in 7/7; the passing control constexpr-filter-01 differs in 0/5 because every element satisfies its predicate. Evaluate predicates in order for each item, stop at the first false predicate, and evaluate/append the element only when all predicates pass. This preserves input order, implements AND semantics, and leaves unused output capacity untouched through the existing kernel store bounds. Reject non-static predicates rather than treating device tensors as Python booleans. Compilation and post-repair device correctness have not been verified; observations establish pre-repair failures only.
